items.description: No invented citation, study, empirical quantity, finding, page, or source appears in committed prose.
Every empirical addition, Croatian or international, names verifiable support; unsupported material is flagged rather than completed.
Every dataset used by the chapter has a verified source and licence and an entry in Dodatak C.
A targeted Quarto render of the chapter succeeds and callouts, citations, figures, and format gates resolve.
No unresolved TODO, placeholder figure, empty required callout, or empty exercise tier remains in the chapter.
No open contradiction, duplicate definition, or broken dependency remains against the shared registries.
The book-style linter and manual pass clear all current STYLE.md hard rules H1-H10.
Each logical figure or widget/static-twin pair has the required prose introduction, and the introduction passes the style check.
Every widget-required chapter has one entry in data/widgets.json and a static print twin; exempt chapters follow conventions.json.
Every non-exempt chapter opens with a non-placeholder callout-vinjeta block.
The chapter spine is ratified, and #def- divs cover only its load-bearing key terms.
The continuity terms check finds no duplicate definition, premature use, inconsistent name, or notation collision.
The chapter closes with substantive Konceptualni, Računski, Kritički, and Revizija modela exercise tiers.
Definition, logical-figure, and callout counts sit inside the provisional conventions bands or carry an approved exception.
Exercises require use and judgment of chapter-spine terms rather than recall alone.
Concepts are introduced before use, and intuition or simulation precedes formalism.
